title: A GTM system for one person's outreach

items.caption: The list: open roles from 450+ job boards, ranked by fit.
The creative: their homepage, with the promise they lead with.
A number from their own site, in their font and colors.
The sequence: a 200-character note, InMail and a warm email.
The signal: who opened it, who pressed play, who finished.
The pipeline: every film from sent to interview.

end: Built and run as a GTM system.
